correctness.rationale: For every d>=3 and ell, the Fischer projection of the signed moment polynomial gives an iff criterion for each Walsh sector. The mixed sector has a nonzero binary null test for all increment indices. The empty and full-index sectors have nonzero binary tests at even indices and nonzero exact transverse derivatives for every odd index>=3, with their k=1 exceptions divisible by the null quadratic. This proves all quantifiers and the exact rank formula without reliance on finite tests. A separate exact-rational checker verifies 1825 small cases and derivative identities as supplementary consistency evidence.

value.rationale: The complete embedded regular hypercube is a canonical spherical sampling set. An all-dimension exact-degree rank classification with two isolated missing characters, especially a one-dimensional defect at d+2 despite earlier full parity rank, is a nontrivial and motivated exact interpolation result; it identifies the sharp universal eventual threshold d+3. The claim avoids numerical-only or arbitrary-slice significance and specifies stability and partial-vertex limits.
